plans.label: Texen (Fighting gym) – Sheridan
plans.notes: Multi battle: you bring 3, Aelita brings Staraptor/Blaziken/Hawlucha. High Striker physical Fighting & slam moves roll 0.5x–3x; Swords Dance +3, Dragon Dance +2/+2, Sing never misses; Make It Rain & Acrobatics 1.5x.

plans.label: Ancient Guard #1 (Gravity/Trick Room) – Garufa Sanctuary (Adam path)
plans.notes: Only if you brought Adam. Gravity + Trick Room team. Deep Earth: Ground 1.5x vs non-Ground, Rock & Psychic 1.3x, Gravity always on (Levitate/Flying get hit by Ground), priority moves 0.7x.

plans.label: Ancient Guard #2 (Rock team) – Garufa Sanctuary (Adam path)
plans.notes: Only if you brought Adam. Tyranitar/Gigalith sand; Matrix Shot on most of them.

plans.label: Behemoth Groudon (boss) – Garufa Sanctuary
plans.notes: Boss, 1 shield, Drought sun. Its Earthquake gets Deep Earth's 1.5x vs non-Ground; Ground types resist Ground here. Water is halved in sun.

plans.label: Crawli (Head Ranger) – Jynnobi Pass
plans.notes: Bug/Grass/Water 1.3x, Fire 0.8x, Earthquake/Bulldoze 0.25x; grounded mons lose 1 Speed every turn; Sticky Web lead.

plans.label: Neved (optional) – Valor Shore
plans.notes: Only if you choose "We win and save Nim". Beach: Surf/Muddy Water/Razor Shell/Crabhammer 1.5x, mud moves 2x, Aura Sphere/Focus Blast/Zen Headbutt 1.3x.

plans.label: Eli & Sharon (10 mons) – Valor Cliffside
plans.notes: Venam is your partner. Rock & Flying 1.5x, Hyper Voice/Icy Wind/Thunder 1.5x (Thunder never misses).

plans.label: Jenner – Valor Summit
plans.notes: 6v4. Volcanic Top: Fire/Flying/Rock 1.5x, Ice 0.5x, Surf/Muddy Water 0.5x.

plans.label: Geara & Zetta (12 mons) – Valor Summit
plans.notes: Melia is your partner. Fire/Flying/Rock 1.5x (Rock gains Fire), Ice 0.5x, Water 0.9x, Surf/Muddy Water/Hydro Pump/Water Spout 0.5x; Earthquake/Earth Power cause eruptions (1/8 to non-Fire).

plans.label: Rift Giratina (boss) – Rift Distortion
plans.notes: Boss Rift Giratina (Ghost/Poison) + crested Relicanth + crested Swalot. Hazards are consumed (Spikes 1/3 HP per layer); Earthquake 0.25x; sludge moves 1.2x.

plans.label: Amber (Lyric Badge gym) – Club STFU
plans.notes: Sound 1.5x; starts at No Hype (minimum rolls). All-Fire team.
